card.title: Compound ZX-7 Reduces Tumor Volume in a Mouse Model (Preliminary)
card.methods: 30 mice, single dose, 4-week follow-up. Preliminary; no human trials.
card.main_findings: ZX-7 reduced average tumor volume by ~20% versus control in mice.
card.limitations: Animal model only; preliminary; not tested in humans.

ledger.claim: ZX-7 shrank tumors by about 20% in a preliminary mouse study.
ledger.source_evidence: ZX-7 reduced average tumor volume by ~20% versus control in mice.
ledger.qualifier: in mice; preliminary; not tested in humans

title_options: 抗癌新突破：新药 ZX-7 能缩小肿瘤
draft.body: 重大突破！新药 ZX-7 被证实可以缩小肿瘤，缩小幅度高达 20%。这意味着癌症患者很快就有了新的治疗选择。
